correctness.rationale: For each a divisible by three, normalized unit-input branches have unit derivative and fill exactly \(\pm1+9\mathbb Z_3\). For \(a=3b\) the zero branch is \(27(t^3-bt)\), whose derivative is always a unit and whose image is \(3\mathbb Z_3\) or \(\mathbb Z_3\) according to b modulo 3. For a divisible by nine, \(27F_{a/9}\) gives an exact recursive zero branch. Unit terminal cases are proved by another derivative computation and square scaling, yielding complete formulas. Disjoint cylinders establish every precision count and Haar density. A standalone checker independently enumerates 1464 parameter/precision cases and 488 complete sets; no finite sample is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The object is the complete value set of a canonical low-degree Dickson polynomial over the rings \(\mathbb Z/3^k\mathbb Z\), not an arbitrary coefficient slice. Its natural invariants (finite-depth image size and 3-adic Haar measure) have two sharply different valuation-one phases, an exact all-parameter recurrence, and a geometric limit at \(a=0\). This is a complete structural classification over an infinite nonunit family, with precise local cylinders useful for lifting, image-density and congruence questions; elementary proof tools alone do not trivialize the new phase classification.
